test_epsilon_greedy_tie_breaking: test the policy_ops.epsilon_greedy function with equal action values and zero epsilon to verify uniform distribution
test_epsilon_greedy_greedy: test the policy_ops.epsilon_greedy function with one largest action value and zero epsilon to verify deterministic greedy policy
test_epsilon_greedy_distribution: test the policy_ops.epsilon_greedy function with non-zero epsilon to verify correct probability distribution
test_epsilon_greedy_batched: test the policy_ops.epsilon_greedy function with batched action values to verify batched probability outputs
test_epsilon_greedy_legal_actions_mask: test the policy_ops.epsilon_greedy function with a legal actions mask to verify masked action probabilities
